newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia's Estring available in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia's Estring available in U.S..

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Tuesday that its Estring vaginal ring was now available by prescription in the United States.
Factory shipments have begun, and Estring is available in doctors' offices and pharmacies nationwide.

Estring releases a low, continuous dose of estradiol, an estrogen produced by the ovaries, for 90 days. It is indicated for treating local symptoms associated with postmenopausal atrophy of the vagina and/or the lower urinary tract.
First approved in Sweden in 1993, Estring is currently available in many countries, including the United Kingdom, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa and Switzerland.
